title: Pavlova
description: Crisp-shelled meringue with a soft marshmallow centre, topped with whipped cream and fresh seasonal fruit. An Australian icon.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 120°C. Draw a 22 cm circle on a sheet of baking paper and place on a baking tray, pencil side down.
In a clean, grease-free bowl, whip egg whites to stiff peaks using an electric mixer.
Gradually add caster sugar, a spoonful at a time, beating continuously until the mixture is very thick, glossy, and the sugar has completely dissolved — rub a little between your fingers to check.
Gently fold in vinegar, cornflour, and vanilla extract until just combined.
Mound the meringue onto the circle, shaping it into a nest with a slight dip in the centre and soft peaks around the edges.
Bake for 90 minutes. Turn the oven off and leave the pavlova inside with the door closed to cool completely — ideally overnight.
Just before serving, top with whipped cream and arrange fresh strawberries, kiwi, passionfruit pulp, and mango slices over the cream.

notes.title: Sugar Dissolving
notes.content: The key to a successful pavlova is ensuring the sugar is fully dissolved before baking. Rub a little meringue between your fingers — if it feels grainy, keep beating. Undissolved sugar causes weeping beads on the surface during baking.

notes.title: Cooling
notes.content: Leave the pavlova in the turned-off oven with the door closed until completely cool. Rapid temperature change causes cracking and collapse. Overnight cooling gives the best result.
